description: This file defines the GlobalAcceleratorClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, providing method signatures for interacting with the AWS Global Accelerator service, including synchronous and asynchronous methods.

classes.name: GlobalAcceleratorClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Global Accelerator service, providing methods for managing accelerators, endpoints, and related resources.

methods.name: addCustomRoutingEndpoints
methods.description: Adds custom routing endpoints to an accelerator.

methods.name: addCustomRoutingEndpointsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds custom routing endpoints to an accelerator.

methods.name: createAccelerator
methods.description: Creates a new AWS Global Accelerator.

methods.name: deleteAccelerator
methods.description: Deletes an existing AWS Global Accelerator.
